item.title: Tour the Lake Erie “Grape Belt” in Western New York State
item.description: The grape growing region of eastern Lake Erie in western New York state offers a great blend of tastes, activities, and adventures. Nicknamed “America’s Grape Country,” this 50-mile long and 3-5 mile wide strip of vineyards, beaches, and quaint villages is a fantastic road trip and vacation getaway destination.

item.description: The craft beverage scene is booming in Chautauqua County, New York, a destination that has been a long time praised for its wine region, Lake Erie Wine Country. item.title: 5 Top Spring Events in Chautauqua & Lake Erie NY
item.description: After a long winter, spring is a welcome return of warmer weather to Western New York. As the days grow longer and buds begin to blossom, Chautauqua & Lake Erie NY comes alive with a calendar packed full of festive events. From a spring ski party to the sweet tastes of locally made maple syrup and blooming lakeside villages, here are five standout spring events that loved by locals and visitors alike.
